target: Carry the LMR/SEPP citation end-to-end so the capacity card cites the actual clause that drives the LMR uplift, and gate the LMR note on a real citation (no clause -> no claim).
findings_summary: housing_sepp_standards ALREADY has citation columns (source_clause, source_document, legislation_url, effective_date, verified_at) — verified live: multi_dwelling=cl 172(2)*, residential_flat_r1r2=174, r3r4_inner=175, r3r4_outer=176, doc 'SEPP (Housing) 2021 - LMR Amendment', eff 2025-02-28, url legislation.nsw.gov.au. But services/housing_sepp_eligibility.py _fetch_standards_grouped SELECTs only development_type,standard_type,numeric_value,applicable_zones,requires_lmr_area — it DROPS the citation, so FormEligibility carries none, so the brief's LMR determination + the #566 card note are UNCITED. Fix: (1) _fetch_standards_grouped also SELECT source_clause,source_document,legislation_url,effective_date and store first-non-null per dev_type (effective_date -> isoformat str); (2) FormEligibility + its _result closure carry the 4 citation fields; (3) intelligence_brief._lmr_uplift_form returns (engine_form, citation_dict) for the winning densest form instead of just the form (2 internal call sites, both updated); (4) ConstraintArithmeticResult gains lmr_source_clause/lmr_source_document/lmr_legislation_url/lmr_effective_date, set at the call site ONLY when ceiling_from_lmr AND a clause is present; (5) the card renders the note ONLY when ceiling_from_lmr && lmr_source_clause (citation present) — otherwise NO claim, with the clause + document + legislation link shown. Read-only extra columns, no new query (same table), no migration, no write. Fail-safe unchanged: any failure -> no uplift -> no citation -> no note. Tests: eligibility carries citation; uplift returns citation; note gated on citation. GO.
